thread:
Maya: anyone up for a midnight Champions League watch in the office? kickoff ~00:30 GMT so it'll be late but I can bring a portable speaker :soccer:
Sam: count me in if there are snacks. sushi or bagels? vote with emoji :sushi: :baguette_bread:
Liam: sushi for me. also can we queue the game in the big room? the HDMI on the old TV still works, right?
Priya: I can bring coffee and a couple of travel mugs. 00:30 GMT is 8:30pm local for me, doable. :coffee:
Sam: also quick fantasy heads-up — my striker went limp in warmups, might drop him to FA. anyone want a low-risk pick?
Maya: which striker? (team name?)
Sam: Mateo Cruz from Valencia, questionable for the week. worth a 1-for-1 if someone needs upside. DM me.
Liam: trade sounds good, but also side bet: loser brings lunch on Monday? :grin:
Priya: agreed, but only if loser brings sushi AND bagels so nobody loses out :joy:
DevBot: created calendar event: "CL Midnight Watch" on 2026-04-08T00:30Z in #random. Additions: reminder 15m. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/CL-midwatch (auto-timezone enabled)
Maya: perfect. I pinned the event to the channel.
Zoe: i'll bring a tiny victory foam finger if my team wins :party_parrot: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-crowd-cheer-3o6gbbuLW76jkt8vIc
Priya: quick poll: who wants the big room vs small lounge? react :one: for big room, :two: for small lounge
Sam: :one:
Liam: :one: (big room for volume)
Maya: :two: (cozier)
DevBot: poll recorded: big room 2, small lounge 1.
Maya: ok big room it is. bringing extension cords and a HDMI adapter.
Sam: i'll drop off sushi at 11:50pm, Priya will handle coffee, Maya handles AV. See y'all there — and DM me about the Cruz trade if you're interested. :thumbsup:
